objections.about: Step 3 says you install each skill once and use it in Claude Code, Desktop and Cowork, but the install section says those tabs do not share a local-file install path. The customer's ~/.claude/skills copy covers only Claude Code, so step 3 contradicts step 1 and could mislead them.

The reply tells the customer to upload one skill's ZIP and leaves out 'Repeat for each required skill' and the advice to install the writing-workflow skills together. content-coach calls the other skills behind the scenes, so uploading only content-coach may not work for them.

The customer says they already restarted the laptop. The reply doesn't acknowledge this, and it doesn't use the 'Confirm it loaded' guidance, which says a generic response doesn't prove the skill loaded.
